section_summary.extract_value: This section details the Center for Epidemiologic Studies Depression Scale (CES-D; Radloff, 1977), a 20-item measure used to assess depressive symptoms at baseline. Participants rated symptoms on a 4-point scale, with possible scores ranging from 0 to 60, where higher scores indicate greater depressive symptoms. The CES-D demonstrated high internal consistency with a Cronbach's α of 0.88.
